answer: Submitting an answer locks 12 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The plume escrow is released only against a ember receipt, and the garden audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 69 aliases means carrying 36 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 12 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
